voz_guia.nota: Parte 2e-1: Maelis, la guia de los santuarios (voz de mujer serena). Frases 1-10, tomas a y b.

1.prompt: [softly] Another soul the Shadow has dragged back from the dark... [pause] You should be dead, marked one. And yet... the fire still answers to you.

2.prompt: [calm] I am /ˈmeɪlɪs/. I tend the soul fires, as my sisters did... before Valdrenn fell to its oath.

3.prompt: [softly] Rest beside them when you can. The fire mends your flesh and fills your flasks... [pause] but the fallen will rise again.

4.prompt: [slowly] It is older than the kingdom. It feeds on broken oaths... [whispers] and it hungers for a door. Yours is the hand it chose to open it.

5.prompt: [softly] Because it needs you. Each time you fall, it pulls you back... and your echoes stay behind, in a sword of light. [pause] Do not lose them twice.

6.prompt: [warmly] Then give me the echoes you carry. I will weave them into your flesh... and your bones.

7.prompt: [softly] May the fire keep you, marked one.

8.prompt: [warmly] You have returned. Good... the fire was waiting for you.

9.prompt: [softly] The king's oath is broken at last. I felt every fire burn brighter... [whispers] and the Shadow grow hungrier.

10.prompt: [sad] Ser Gavran kept his oath to the very end. Honor him, marked one... few in Valdrenn ever did.

voz_herrero.nota: Parte 2e-2: Dorvan, el herrero. Frases 1-8, tomas a y b.

1.prompt: [gruff] Hm. Another one crawling out of the dark with a dull blade... The name's Dorvan. I keep the forge of Valdrenn burning, oath or no oath.

2.prompt: [gruff] Back again? Show me what you've been swinging.

3.prompt: Bring me forging stones and echoes, and I'll make that steel sing.

4.prompt: [satisfied] There. Sharper than the day it was forged. Try not to break it on the first skull.

5.prompt: [grumbling] You're short on stones, or on echoes. The forge doesn't work for free.

6.prompt: [sighs] The king swore an oath to something that should never have heard it. After that... the forge was all I had left to keep my hands from shaking.

7.prompt: [gruff] Off you go, then. And keep your guard up.

8.prompt: [chuckles] That one's as good as it gets. Not even I can push it further.

voz_mercader.nota: Parte 2e-2: Kerrick, el mercader. Frases 1-6, tomas a y b.

1.prompt: [cheerfully] Ah, a customer! And a living one, more or less. Kerrick's the name. If it can be carried, I've probably got it.

2.prompt: [warmly] Welcome back, friend! Echoes in your pocket, wares on my cart.

3.prompt: [pleased] A fine choice. Spend it well... or don't, and come buy another.

4.prompt: [sighs] Ah... your purse is lighter than your ambition, friend.

5.prompt: [chuckles] The dead don't care much for my prices. The living do. So I stay close to the fires... and closer to my cart.

6.prompt: Safe roads, friend. And if you find any... do tell me.

arco_tensar.prompt: An old wooden longbow being drawn: the slow creak and strain of the bow limbs bending and the taut bowstring stretching back, tense and close up, dark fantasy, about 1 second, no music, clean

arco_suelta.prompt: An arrow released from a heavy longbow: a sharp deep bowstring twang and a fast whoosh of the arrow flying away, crisp and close, dark fantasy, about 0.8 seconds, no music

arquero_alerta.prompt: An undead skeleton archer noticing an intruder: a dry rattling clatter of old bones and a raspy hollow hiss from a fleshless skull, eerie and threatening, dark fantasy RPG enemy alert sound, about 1.2 seconds, no music

arquero_huesos.prompt: Idle undead skeleton: soft dry clicking and rattling of old bones shifting, a faint creak of a loose jaw, quiet and eerie, close, about 1.8 seconds, no music

arquero_dolor.prompt: A skeleton warrior being struck by a sword: a hard crack of brittle bone with a short dry rattle, punchy and impactful, dark fantasy combat hurt sound, about 0.6 seconds, no music

arquero_muerte.prompt: A skeleton warrior collapsing and dying: bones cracking apart and clattering down onto a stone floor in a heap, a dry hollow hiss fading out, dark fantasy RPG death sound, about 2 seconds, no music

sfx_valdrenn_perros_espectros.nota: Parte 4b: el perro de hueso (grunido, ladrido, aullido, mordisco, dolor, muerte) y el espectro de la corte (susurro, alerta, lamento, zarpazo, desvanecerse, dolor, muerte). Las 4 tomas de cada uno se bajan como NOMBRE_1..4

perro_grunido.prompt: A skeletal undead hound growling low: a dry, rattling, guttural growl from a fleshless throat, jaw bones clicking and loose vertebrae rattling, dark fantasy RPG creature idle sound like Dark Souls, no music, about 2 seconds

perro_ladrido.prompt: An undead skeleton dog spotting its prey: two harsh, hollow, rasping barks that echo out of an empty ribcage, bones rattling as it lunges forward, dark fantasy RPG enemy alert sound like Dark Souls, no music, about 1.5 seconds

perro_aullido.prompt: A skeletal hellhound howling to call its pack: one long, eerie, hollow, ghostly howl with a dry rattling undertone, echoing across a stone castle courtyard at night, dark fantasy, no music, about 3 seconds

perro_mordisco.prompt: The bony jaws of a skeletal dog snapping shut hard: a sharp clack of teeth, a short vicious snarl and bones rattling, punchy close combat sound, dark fantasy, no music, under 1 second

perro_dolor.prompt: A skeletal undead dog being struck by a sword: a short pained hollow yelp mixed with cracking bone and a rattle, dark fantasy creature hurt sound, no music, under 1 second

perro_muerte.prompt: A skeletal hound collapsing dead: a last rasping whimper fading out while its bones clatter and scatter onto a stone floor, dark fantasy creature death sound like Dark Souls, no music, about 2 seconds

espectro_susurro.prompt: The ghost of a royal courtier drifting through a haunted castle hall: faint, breathy, unintelligible whispers and a cold airy moan with a soft ethereal shimmer, dark fantasy enemy idle sound, no music, about 3 seconds

espectro_alerta.prompt: A spectral ghost noticing an intruder: a sudden chilling distorted shriek that rises and echoes, with an icy whoosh, dark fantasy enemy alert sound like Dark Souls, no music, about 1.5 seconds

espectro_lamento.prompt: A banshee-like court spectre's mournful wail attack: a long piercing ghostly scream that swells, layered with echoing sorrowful voices and a freezing gust of wind, dark fantasy magic attack sound, no music, about 2.5 seconds

espectro_zarpazo.prompt: A ghost's spectral claw swipe: a fast icy airy whoosh with a faint ghostly hiss and a crystalline shimmer at the end, dark fantasy combat sound, no music, under 1 second

espectro_desvanece.prompt: A ghost vanishing and reappearing a few steps away: a reversed ethereal whoosh that sucks inward, a cold shimmer and a soft ghostly sigh, dark fantasy teleport sound, no music, about 1 second

espectro_dolor.prompt: A spectral ghost being hit by a sword: a short distorted ghostly gasp with a crackle like breaking ice and an echoing hiss, dark fantasy enemy hurt sound, no music, under 1 second

espectro_muerte.prompt: A court spectre dissolving into nothing: a long fading sorrowful sigh that breaks apart into whispers and an icy shimmer that drifts away, dark fantasy enemy death sound like Dark Souls, no music, about 2.5 seconds
